what: H12 deploy-doctor: supervisor kill/restart tests + full start-from-zero rehearsal, all on SCRATCH instances (private ports, isolated cwd). The live stack (engine 8107, shell 8206, site 8210) was never stopped, restarted, or health-disturbed beyond read-only curls.

supervisor_coverage_test.config: .h12_scratch/scratch_dummies.json (3 dummy HTTP pieces on 8245/8246/8247, same health modes as the real pieces)
supervisor_coverage_test.cold_boot_all_three: 08:18:08 first down -> 08:18:16 last up = ~8 s sequential

single_kill_engine_dummy.note: worst case: detection waited the full 5 s poll interval

supervisor_coverage_test.clean_shutdown: watchdog_stopped children_terminated=3, all three ports closed (verified by netstat + curl 000)
supervisor_coverage_test.verdict: PASS - all three services covered by health checks + auto-restart, single and simultaneous

start_from_zero_rehearsal.config: .h12_scratch/scratch_real.json (REAL pieces, private ports: engine 8137 from an isolated cwd copy, shell 8246, site 8245; shell/site loopback, health-checked only)

attempt_1_engine_FAIL.what_happened: exe copied WITHOUT shaders/ -> engine process started, wrote a 0-byte session jsonl, never opened the port, died; watchdog retried (2 attempts per ~85 s cycle) and STILL brought shell + site up
attempt_1_engine_FAIL.lesson: the engine piece ships as exe + shaders/ (the launcher dir has both); a deploy that copies only the exe boots nothing. Runbook failure call-tree now names this signature.

attempt_2_full_stack_PASS.engine_8137: starting 08:24:30 -> up 08:24:31 (~1 s boot with shaders/ present; /tick_state returns real ticks JSON)
attempt_2_full_stack_PASS.proxy_check: GET :8246/api/state proxied to the engine and returned live world JSON (one read-only request)

start_from_zero_rehearsal.shutdown_contract_validation: watchdog max-seconds exit -> watchdog_stopped children_terminated=3; the DIRECTLY-spawned engine child was verified gone (port closed, PID absent). With the OLD bat-wrapper config the engine always survived shutdown (the `start ""` in launch_chimera.bat detaches it; the watchdog's child was a cmd wrapper that exits instantly).
start_from_zero_rehearsal.bare_exe_resolution_test: config with bare 'chimera_engine.exe' + piece-relative cwd boots and shuts down cleanly through the real supervisor code path (08:30:19 -> 08:30:35, children_terminated=1); Python's Popen does NOT resolve a relative exe against cwd= (WinError 2), so the resolution step was added to start_chimera.py::spawn
start_from_zero_rehearsal.final_config_check: python tools/supervisor/start_chimera.py --config tools/deploy/pieces_public.json -> 'stack already up', exit 0, live stack untouched

live_stack_observations.binding: dev stack on 127.0.0.1 for all three (runbook step 2 exists precisely so the public 0.0.0.0 bindings win at go-live)
live_stack_observations.pii_timeline: website process started 9/13 21:56:41 (watchdog-restarted) predated the hardening commit 879cf69d (9/13 22:47) and SERVED tools/website/signups.jsonl raw on GET /signups.jsonl (200, loopback-only, never public). A restart at 9/14 08:19:18 loaded the hardened code; /signups.jsonl now 404s. Guard is in code, not in process state - hence the step-11 PII gate.
